## About

Satria Nugraha is an IT professional specialising in system administration, Microsoft cloud environments, and IT infrastructure. His work centres on keeping dependable systems running, diagnosing complex issues through root cause analysis, and improving operational reliability.

He has supported healthcare IT environments as a sole System Administrator, delivered technical consulting for Microsoft 365 and server infrastructure, and currently works as an independent IT Freelance handling network security (OPNsense, MikroTik) and infrastructure projects.

Currently based in Lamongan, East Java, Indonesia. Open to international opportunities — both remote and relocation.
